scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Stage III & IV Cancer Patients
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant must be a bonafide resident of Haryana as per Government instructions.
Applicant must have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) – Family ID.
All Stage III and IV cancer patients are eligible.
Family income must be less than ₹3,00,000 per annum, excluding amounts received from other Social Security Pension Schemes.
benefits_summary: Monthly financial assistance of ₹3,000 to Stage III and IV cancer patients.
